path_like_string_constants:
Assemble the frozen model-only v2 estimator into one pre-registered candidate.

Every level, weight and parameter here comes from the challenge-provided features
and the frozen component mechanisms already committed in this repo, plus the
organiser's published method. No leaderboard-derived constant enters the candidate:
no `alpha` from the phase-2 probe, no probe region means, no probe beta, no
`E[qy]/E[q]` target moment, and no per-GEOID fit. The removed reference layers
(TIGER, MS footprints, USGS structures, CBP) and any equivalent copy are never
read; the platform template's score placeholder column is never read.

The script writes the frozen scored artifact, its manifest card with a
pre-registered public-RMSE forecast written before any upload, and
``reports/estimator-v2-audit.json``. It performs no upload: the committed
final-two protocol queues zero uploads and requires operator authorization
through the orchestrator gate.
fixed logistic presence priors and the explicit cbp_k = 0.024 establishments parameter, both registered in config/v2-component-mask-audit-preregistered.json
reports/lb-score-algebra.json (historical probe algebra, quoted as background only)

Audit the defined-component masks and composite arithmetic of the frozen v2 estimator.

Validation screen only: it promotes nothing, computes no accuracy estimate, reads no
labels, no removed reference layer or equivalent, no sample-submission score value,
no leaderboard-derived constant, and performs no upload. It reads the official scored
GEOID cells, the provided ACS strata covariates needed to recompute the frozen
fixed-prior presence probability, and the already-frozen provided-feature component
artifacts declared in ``config/v2-component-mask-audit-preregistered.json``.

For every official scored tract the audit checks that each v2 component is treated as
undefined exactly where its model-defined flag is false (undefined rows carry the
documented numeric placeholder only), that every defined component lies in [0, 1] and
reproduces its frozen formula, that the POI halves and the three-component composite
average defined components only, and that the emitted candidate score matches the
recomputed defined-component mean within the registered gate.
